written_after_exposure: THIS ARTIFACT WAS WRITTEN AFTER P1-P9 EXPOSURE. It changes no earlier verdict: P1 remains UNRESOLVED, P7 remains FAIL, P9 remains FAIL in their original artifacts.

adjustment.evidence: MASSIVE_1M_P1B_EXECUTION_V1: TSLA r = 0.9828 against an unadjusted band of 2.70-3.30, AMZN r = 0.9769 against 18.00-22.00. Both land in the adjusted band and agree.
adjustment.parameter: the `adjusted` request parameter is NOT inert — true and false return different response digests
adjustment.consequence: no split-adjustment layer is required. Vendor RESTATEMENT becomes the live concern instead: an adjusted history can change retroactively, so every extract records its vintage and a restatement is stored as a NEW vintage alongside the old one, never in place of it.

vw.evidence: P7: vw falls outside its own bar's [low, high] on 1/390 AAPL bars, 5/390 MSFT, and 95/140 NVR

correction_to_frozen_spec.spec_said: vw is discarded and every VWAP feature is recomputed from OHLCV or removed
correction_to_frozen_spec.defect: a true VWAP CANNOT be reconstructed from OHLCV — it is a property of the trades within the bar, and HLC3 x volume and its relatives are proxies for a different quantity
correction_to_frozen_spec.resolution: the VWAP feature family is DISABLED for V1 rather than substituted

proxy_rule.permitted_later: an OHLCV-based construct may be built, but it must be named OHLCV_VWAP_PROXY, never VWAP
proxy_rule.requires: its own preregistration stating what it measures and what it does not
proxy_rule.why: a proxy carrying the name VWAP would inherit the meaning without the measurement, in every study that ever reads the column

vw.reopening: a trade-level source could qualify a real VWAP later; that would be a separate branch
vw.blocks: the VWAP feature family ONLY — OHLCV research is unaffected

n.evidence: P7: no bar carries volume with a missing n, so the field is internally consistent; no independent external quantity was available to establish what it COUNTS

policy.ingestion: n is stored raw and unchanged
policy.features: transaction-count features are on HOLD and stay out of the V1 feature dictionary
policy.resolution_path: a pre-frozen supplemental probe against a trade-level endpoint, if one is available

n.blocking: NOT blocking for canonical OHLCV ingestion

session_close_boundary.conformance: MASSIVE_1M_CLOSE_BOUNDARY_CONFORMANCE_V1 — verdict UNSTABLE, 11 failures across 30 combinations

what_is_stable.lattice: 30/30 — every normal session has exactly 390 regular minutes (09:30-15:59) and every early close exactly 210 (09:30-12:59)
what_is_stable.status: this is the assertion the downstream policy actually rests on, and it held without exception

what_is_not_stable.presence: the boundary bar was ABSENT for XOM on 3 of its 6 sessions — 27/30 present overall
what_is_not_stable.magnitude: on normal sessions the boundary bar ranged from 0.03x to 19.24x the preceding 30-minute median (median 4.60x), while on early-close sessions it ran 28.86x to 87.07x
what_is_not_stable.likely_explanation: the early-close ratios are inflated by a THIN denominator — the last 30 minutes of a half day are quiet, whereas the last 30 minutes of a normal session are already the busiest of the day. Stated as the plausible reading, not as a demonstrated one.
what_is_not_stable.bearing_on_the_name: a boundary bar at 0.03x the preceding median is not an auction under any reading. The neutral name is now supported by evidence, not only by caution.

policy.optional: the boundary bar is OPTIONAL — its absence is a normal outcome and must never be treated as an error or as missing data
policy.three_valued: PRESENT / ABSENT / UNKNOWN, following the same discipline as minute availability
policy.not_a_regular_minute: never counted as a 391st or 211th regular minute
policy.higher_tf: carried into the final session bucket as an explicit, separately labelled endpoint component
policy.forbidden: any feature that assumes the boundary bar exists, or that reads it as auction volume

calendar.qualification: 6/6 against the P9 fixtures frozen before the library was chosen
calendar.authority: the calendar defines sessions; vendor data is measured against it, never the reverse

cross_store.rule: the legacy studio store and Massive 1m are different measurement systems; cross-store equality is NOT ESTABLISHED
cross_store.forbidden: using the legacy store as a validation oracle for Massive, or pooling the two in any study

source_window.rule: the research horizon is stored as ABSOLUTE DATES, never as 'today minus five years'
source_window.end_definition: last fully closed session at freeze time, per the qualified XNYS calendar

entitlement.observed: dates before the boundary return HTTP 403
entitlement.window: five years, ROLLING forward one day per day

recession_risk.statement: freezing an absolute start does not stop the vendor withdrawing it — it only makes the loss visible
recession_risk.consequence: every day of delay costs one day at the start. If ingestion begins later than 2021-08-25 + the elapsed delay, the earliest frozen sessions will already be unavailable and the frozen window becomes partially unfulfillable.
recession_risk.mitigation: INGEST OLDEST-FIRST. The oldest data is the only perishable part; the recent end is not going anywhere.
recession_risk.reporting: any session in the frozen window that cannot be retrieved is recorded as UNAVAILABLE with its 403, never as empty and never silently narrowed

source_window.archive_becomes_authoritative: once ingested, the raw archive is the authoritative historical source, because the same interval may be unfetchable later

ingestion_gate.vw: feature family disabled — does not block ingestion
ingestion_gate.n: feature family on hold — does not block ingestion
ingestion_gate.verdict: ALL BLOCKING ITEMS CLEARED — canonical 1m ingestion is technically unblocked and awaits explicit authorisation, which this artifact does NOT grant
